rules.title: Rules and sources
rules.subtitle: YARA rule sources, ClamAV and LMD signatures, with the result of the last compilation.
rules.compileStarted: Compilation started. The result shows up here when it finishes.
rules.compileBusy: A rule compilation is already running.
rules.executorDown: The executor did not respond: sources and signatures may be incomplete.
rules.adminOnly: Only the administrator compiles rules, enables or disables sources and turns LMD on.

lastCompile.title: Last compilation
lastCompile.none: No compilation recorded. The first scan or the Compile rules button compiles the set.
lastCompile.selftestNotRun: Only tested in compilations requested by the administrator

sources.title: YARA sources
sources.caption: YARA rule sources
sources.enableImpact: This source's rules apply again from the next compilation; compilation starts now, validating each source.
sources.disableImpact: This source's rules stop being used in the next scans. Findings already recorded stay as they are.
sources.userDir: To add a source, create a subdirectory in {{dir}} with .yar files and, optionally, a source.json with description, license, author, address and version. Only root writes there; sources with open permissions, include or over the limits are refused.
sources.emptyDescription: Check that the executor is running and refresh the status.

clamav.title: ClamAV signatures
clamav.lmdLinked: LMD (rfxn) signatures are already in the ClamAV directories and loaded by clamd:
clamav.lmdLinkedNote: Turning LMD on adds only the types ClamAV does not use (SHA-256 and compound signatures).

lmd.title: Linux Malware Detect (LMD)
lmd.role: Additional signature source (MD5, SHA-256, HEX, compound and YARA from the rfxn project), applied to the same file list as the scan. LMD runs without quarantine and without the ClamAV stage: VigiaHost only reads.
lmd.counts: {{md5}} MD5 · {{sha256}} SHA-256 · {{hex}} HEX · {{csig}} compound · {{yara}} YARA · {{user}} user
lmd.enableTitle: Turn LMD on for file scans
lmd.disableTitle: Turn LMD off for file scans
lmd.enableImpact: The next file scans also go through LMD, with quarantine off. Scans take longer.
lmd.disableImpact: The next file scans stop using LMD. Findings already recorded stay as they are.
lmd.toggledOn: LMD turned on for the next file scans.

guidance.missing: LMD 2.x is not installed. To use it, install version 2.0 or newer from the official rfxn project package (github.com/rfxn/linux-malware-detect) and verify the file signature. VigiaHost does not install third-party tools.
guidance.unusable: LMD was found but cannot be used: the detail above shows why (version older than 2.0 or files writable by other users).
guidance.unavailable: LMD is on, but the installation cannot be used: scans record an engine failure until it is fixed or turned off.
guidance.selftestFailed: The LMD self-test failed in the last scan. Open the run shown to see why.
